context.content: Today, I ventured into the MMORPG genre for the first time and I decided to stream it. I wasn't expecting much. Who would want to watch a nobody play a 20-year-old game for the first time. However, a couple of people popped in and gave me some tips and chatted for a while. As someone who uses twitch to destress from my life, this meant the world to me. I am so thankful for a kind community like this.
